reason: I'd take the free six-week test to see if it catches anything my team misses, but I can't put a $2,000 a month line into this year's budget on a tool with no track record here. It has to pay back fast and nobody has shown me that yet.
objection: My ERP partner already gives me exception reports, and I'd have to explain why I'm paying a startup for something close to what I already have. I also don't know how it fits with our Epicor data and what it does to my supplier emails.
would_change_my_mind: A free test on our own open POs that shows a few real late-order catches I could tie to avoided customer penalties, plus a clear answer from my ERP partner that nothing conflicts with their system.
